en: These shards glint with an unnatural sheen.  It is clear that they hide a deep power within.
You'll have to give me a moment, $c, the naga are attacking us right now. I'll speak to you as soon as the attack is done!
Damn you mortals! All my plans of revenge, all my hate... all burned to ash...
You need to be exalted with the tauren of Thunder Bluff before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.
<Sergeant Stormpike salutes.>$B$BName, rank, and serial number, soldier! That's the only bit of information you'll ever give those dirty Frostwolf dogs!
Go about your business. My errand does not require your attention.
Warlocks... I don't care for their lot.  Like that Grimrizz who's set up shop outside the Thunderbrew Distillery. The ale will probably go flat there because of him!  Warlocks... bah!
Khara hums an old dwarven tune while she cooks.
Yes, $c?
If you're going to venture into Blackrock Depths, come speak with me. I may have some work for you.
Hundreds of various diagrams and schematics begin to take shape on the pages of the book. You recognize some of the diagrams while others remain foreign but familiar.
And now... the final step!
In the King's audience chamber you will find the Lady Hoteshem.  She can assist you in getting to Arathi Basin where The League of Arathor is in need of assistance against The Defilers.
Emperor Thaurissan does not wish to be disturbed! Turn back now or face your doom, weak mortals!
Who dares summon me?
Yes.  Give me the spell to summon the avatar.
You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!
Thanks a lot, $n.  We couldn't have made it without you.  Oh, and if I had mentioned before something about repaying you for saving us, well... you can forget it!
I'd like a new invitation to the Lunar Festival.
Druids and your silly shapeshifting. Lets see it in action!

I'm flattered, but really I'm not interested... What?  You want to know where to learn enchanting?  Oh, how embarrassing!  Well, you should...  I'm sure you could... go see, um...  Taladan!  Yes, see Taladan over in the Craftsmen's Terrace!
%s drains your mana and turns to stone.
One has opened up on the Tradesman's Terrace.  If you take the path leading Southeast from the bank, it should be easy to find.

The Shattered Hand's influence dominates these lands. We are the veil which covers Kalimdor: The protectorates, the police, the judges, the jury, and ultimately, the executioners. We see all, we know all.$B$BYou have grown much in the time which you have spent in service of the Hand, $n. The time has come to send you into the field.$B$BAre you prepared to undertake your next mission?
Oops! That was a bit off. I didn't even hit the target!
You would certainly be looking for Me'Lynn if you have any hope of learning to be a tailor.  She resides at the Craftsmen's Terrace in northeastern Darnassus.
I like to build stuff. Of course, I like to blow stuff up even more!
This can't be right. An Old God could never be allowed to enter this world. The results would be... Oh dear!
Continue, please.
True mastery must be earned! It is up to you to earn it now...

I welcome you to Theramore, $n.$B$BI apologize for being abrupt and not having a lot of time to exchange pleasantries, but my city must come first. Too many things threaten our way of life and the sanctity of the Alliance. I must stay ever vigilant against forces outside of our control if I'm to ensure my people remain safe and happy.$B$BPerhaps we'll have more time to speak later.
Do fish ever get thirsty?
I have regained control! Everyone - back to your posts!
What do you know of it?
%s breaks free from his stone slumber!
Your future is clouded.  Concentrate, and ask again.
Almost perfect shot! It's a bit off but I can see where Grumlar would miss with it. He couldn't hit the broad side of a barn.
I just received word on that. We currently have $2021w out of $2020w peacebloom, $2050w of $2051w firebloom, and $2054w out of $2055w purple lotus herbs requested.
Hi, $n.  No hard feelings, ok?
Five tickets or two-hundred and fifty, it doesn't matter friend, everybody is a winner!
Kah Mistrunner at Mountaintop Bait & Tackle on the high rise will show you the way to find inner peace and serenity while fishing for your next meal.

The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out.

If you are initiated in the ways of the $c, I can help you grasp them.
Karnik, me friend, I wish I could see you with me own eyes again, but we need'ta talk of Ragnaros. His influence is spreading.
%s uses his index finger to make a cutting motion across his neck.
Please, champion, protect our people.
Ok, now let's get out of here!
Hey Jangdor - can you teach me again how to make Wild Leather Boots again?
The Scarlet Crusade shall not fail in its mission!

You're a leatherworker by trade, aren't you?  It's that faint smell of cured hides, I'd recognize it anywhere.$B$BMy father used to talk about a famous artisan who lived in Southwind Village centuries ago.  It's a shame the place is in ruins now.
I... I'm not really sure how I got here...$B$BI seem to remember traveling... a raft...$B$B
I am so glad that you asked.  You will find Sir Malory Wheeler at the Royal Quarter in the presence of our Dark Lady.
Waiting to crush the life from our little ones. To slay all in their path. This they do for their god.
Down goes Frazier!  Down goes Frazier! Down goes...huh?  That Wasn't Frazier?
<Remain Silent>
Are the Eastern Plaguelands currently under attack?
Run if you like fools!  Your fate is sealed anyways!
